kind: Prospective source-evidenced semantic alignment audit of all original Core560; AI agreement is not certified gold
state: prepared protocol only; no actual model calls authorized by this file

population.selection: all original Core IDs sorted lexicographically; no filtering by outcomes or audit acceptance

resource_limits.concurrency_lock: one runner per frozen input directory; four thread workers maximum
resource_limits.measurement: Linux /proc statm resident pages summed for registered audit process groups only; shared pages may be counted more than once
resource_limits.bound: Sampled soft abort guard, not a cgroup hard allocation limit. Child processes that leave the registered group are not observed. No address-space cap is imposed because the local Node launcher/native binary can reserve virtual space without resident allocation.
resource_limits.budget_action: At sampled aggregate RSS above 8 GiB, each affected worker terminates only its own registered CLI process group; preserve invalid receipt, no retry.

freshness_and_independence.A_order: ascending IDs within each fixed ten-item batch
freshness_and_independence.B_order: reverse of the same fixed batch IDs
freshness_and_independence.limits: Procedural independence only; same requested model can make correlated errors. CLI built-in system prompt/provider model identity/internal retries not fully observed.

reader_allowlist: fixed original declared reference-target versus generated-model first-column canonical-set scoring semantics
source-native field names/native datatype classes/JSON type sets and observed recursive-JSON-supported boolean/null only
deterministic evidence_spans catalogue of the same allowed source strings, exact span IDs/quotes/Unicode offsets
reader_excludes: prior audit or success cohort membership

native_metadata.input: C per-item source-native receipt directory or fields-only aggregate; exact original query UTF8 SHA must match
native_metadata.projection: native_column_name,observed_native_datatypes,observed_json_type_kinds; observed_json_supported boolean/null derived from recursive source measurement, never raw counts
native_metadata.not_observed: explicitly separate from unsupported; do not invent support by static inspection
native_metadata.support_meaning: JSON representation support only, not source truth or question meaning
native_metadata.operational_native_applicability: C reports query errors/caps/native readiness independently; not hidden in semantic agreement
native_metadata.unsupported_detection: C recursive unsupported_json_value_count>0 maps to observed_json_supported=false. Zero measured values map to null/unknown. Top-level array/object kinds alone cannot certify support.

independent_labels: host-derived original_full_contract diagnostic (not a model output)

label_definitions.aligned: Original formal question/query/scored-field alignment supported by supplied artifacts; not independent truth or expert certification. Requires no unknown/ambiguous required dimensions or blockers.
label_definitions.misaligned: Explicit mismatch in requested query output or scored-field coverage, including a correct identifier but an uncovered required value/count/role.
label_definitions.unresolved: Underspecified question,ambiguous query/scope/ties,external semantics,unknown evidence,or inconsistent readiness remains explicit. No question repair is implied.
label_definitions.native_unsupported: Only measured non-JSON native type observation; separate from semantic alignment and source completeness.

evidence.catalogue: Each source whole span; nonempty query lines and keyword-started query fragments outside quoted strings/backticks/comments. Fragment discovery is a lexical catalogue, not a Cypher semantic parser.
evidence.model_fields: span_id,source,quote,reason; quote and source must match the fixed catalogue exactly. Models never count offsets.
evidence.offsets: Host-only derived Unicode code-point start inclusive/end exclusive; original model evidence bytes preserved, no postjudgment repair.
evidence.validation: Each dimension,requested/extra field,blocker and conclusion cites at least one supplied exact span. All evidence resolves to frozen source hash and catalogue offsets; mismatch is an invalid preserved receipt.
evidence.requested_output_mapping: Each requested field includes returned_column_names; all names must match observed source-native column names exactly. Empty is explicit missing or ambiguous mapping. Returning a field is not evidence that the question required it.

full_contract_invariants: Never infer question demand from every returned column.
A bare list does not silently specify a LIMIT.
Query ORDER BY does not create a question ordering requirement.
Declared contract labels are claims to inspect,not ground truth.
Original first scored field is distinct from all returned or declared fields.
Missing field,role/count/scope/order/completeness defects are not concealed by identifiers.
Unknown/native operational readiness and external semantics remain separate.

call_policy.authorization: Separate root authorization pins exact protocol,code,frozen_input_manifest,raters[A,B],maxCLI112 before run
call_policy.retry_policy: One durable reservation per rater/batch. Valid,invalid,timeout,tool-action and interrupted reservations are preserved; no automatic relaunch or answer-driven retry.
call_policy.tools: Prompt prohibits tools/files/web. Empty isolated scratch cwd,ignore-user-config/ignore-rules,ephemeral,read-only sandbox,web_search disabled; captured tool action invalidates audit. Read-only sandbox alone is not an isolation proof.
call_policy.events: Capture raw private stdout/stderr/events,usage,return code,timing,prompt/schema pins and validation errors; unknown provider retries are not counted as verified HTTP calls.

analysis_plan.complete_denominator: 560 original IDs per independent rater; missing/invalid batches reported,never treated as alignment success
analysis_plan.agreement: Itemwise agreement of independent question/query/scored-field/native/required-column+role/signature labels and separately host-derived full-contract diagnostics; preserve all disagreements and both rationales
analysis_plan.adjudication: No automatic majority vote,no hidden repair. Any later adjudication is a separately frozen author-side action,not human/expert validation.
analysis_plan.overlap75: Historical75 IDs may be joined after audit closure solely by original IDs for lineage;membership and old judgments never enter fresh auditor inputs.
analysis_plan.performance: No new predictions or performance/reviewer rating inference. Scope-specific alignment counts are diagnostics,not domain semantic accuracy.

synthetic_tests: strict schema/parser and frozen span ID/source/quote validation
host Unicode offsets from catalogue, no model offset counting
quoted query keywords not false catalogue clause boundaries
gold/history/count exclusion
native names/types/recursive-supported-boolean projection only
missing or duplicate dimensions/IDs rejected
invented native support rejected
uncovered requested count cannot be aligned
exact native returned_column_names accepted; invented names rejected
unrelated not-requested unknown dimensions do not invalidate otherwise aligned verdict
RSS measurement includes only registered groups; synthetic filesystem, no CLI process launched
calls blocked without separate root authorization
nested array native Node/Path unsupported despite top-level array
zero observed values remain unknown
declared reference gold field may be a later RETURN position
closed role_code enforced
unknown nested signature remains unresolved
unasked query limit remains host-derived misaligned
invented native order keys rejected
model original_full_contract removed; deterministic host diagnostic, no redundant clerical mismatch

preparation_amendment.reason: Before any actual AI calls: preserve static_v1 and replace guessed Unicode offsets with deterministic span IDs; add exact source-native returned-column mapping; detect recursive JSON support without values/counts; replace fragile per-process virtual-memory cap with CPU affinity and explicit sampled aggregate RSS guard. Final pre-call source review clarifies declared reference target versus model first-column extraction and adds closed role/collection/nested/order/cap/tie/scope signatures; removes redundant model full-contract verdict and derives it deterministically on the host.

previous_native_fields_v1.snapshots: native_fields_v1/code_snapshot.py and protocol_snapshot.json; original fixtures unchanged

ontology_context.rule: Supplied query labels/relationships and value-free native shape support formal artifact alignment only. Domain/process semantics not defined in the original question/query must be unknown or external_semantics_required; do not invent ontology conventions.

original_scoring_policy.reference_target: declared original_scored_field canonical value set; reference RETURN position need not be zero
original_scoring_policy.model_prediction: first returned column of the generated model query canonical value set
original_scoring_policy.other_fields: Additional returned columns are not independently scored; question-required columns must be assessed independently
original_scoring_policy.normalization: original published canonicalization, whitespace collapse and case-folding; row order and duplicate multiplicity ignored

machine_contract_signature.kind: original-question demands, never inferred from query ORDER/LIMIT or existing scored-set policy alone

fields.order_key_columns: array of exact observed native column names; no duplicates
fields.cap_value: nonnegative integer or null; unknown remains null

machine_contract_signature.compiler_limit: No contract/gold creation from column-role agreement alone. Both auditors must source-evidence the same complete collection/nested/order/cap/tie/scope signature; unsupported or unresolved remains explicit.

precedence: misaligned if reference-query mismatch, original-scored-field partial/missing/wrong, any required dimension query mismatch or partial/not-covered scoring, any requested field partial/not-covered, unasked query LIMIT, or scope mismatch

else unresolved if question not well specified, query not aligned, original scored-field coverage not full, any blocker, any ambiguous demand or unknown/nonaligned required dimension, any noncovered requested field, any unresolved signature component, explicit requested cap with unknown numeric value, sequence without named native order keys, or cutoff with no_cutoff policy
else aligned; unknown not-requested dimensions alone do not invalidate
host_derived_full_contract.certification: AI artifact alignment diagnostic only; human/domain-expert validation zero
